auth.welcomeTitle: Sign in to manage releases and access

oidcErrors.stateInvalid: This sign-in session has expired or was already used. Please start again.
oidcErrors.tokenExchangeFailed: Portal could not issue a Console sign-in credential. Please try again shortly.
oidcErrors.userinfoFailed: Your Portal identity information could not be read. Please try again shortly.
oidcErrors.identityInvalid: Your Portal account cannot sign in to Console at this time.
oidcErrors.adminRoleRequired: This Portal account does not have Console administrator access.
oidcErrors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during sign-in. Please try again.

pclHomepage.title: PCL Launcher Homepage
pclHomepage.description: Edit the PCL custom-homepage XAML for each HydCraft Portal server.
pclHomepage.alreadyFormatted: XAML already matches the current format.
pclHomepage.formatFailed: XAML syntax is invalid and cannot be formatted.
pclHomepage.variableDescription: Variables are replaced with the server's current data when PCL requests the public XAML.

variables.serverStatus: Server status: ONLINE when Portal Bridge is connected, otherwise OFFLINE; the Portal configuration status is used without live bridge data.
variables.onlinePlayers: Current online player count; 0 when live data is unavailable.
variables.latestClientVersion: Latest published client version for this server; empty when none is found.
variables.latestClientPublishedAt: Publication date of that client version in Shanghai YYYY/M/D format; empty when none is found.
variables.latestClientPublisher: Publisher of that client version, preferring display name then username; empty when unset.
variables.currentDate: Current date in Shanghai YYYY/M/D format.
variables.todayRequestCount: Today's PCL homepage requests for this server. The current request is included, using Shanghai calendar days.

errors.invalidManifest: The manifest must be valid JSON with schemaVersion 1.
errors.requestFailed: The request did not complete. Check permissions, input, and service configuration.
